cards.title: What is this?
points: **Present perfect** — past with a link to **now** (*I have moved*)
Same verb idea — different time picture

cards.title: Past simple — when?
points: The time is closed. The story step is finished.

rows: I **have lost** my keys. (I don’t have them now.)
I **have lived** here for 12 years. (I still do.)

cards.title: Why it matters
points: Listeners hear **then** as a finished step → past simple
Present perfect with **then** often sounds wrong

cards.title: Picture in your head
points: If the story says **then / after that**, use past simple.

cards.title: Common mistakes

rows: Then I have moved to a village.
I lived here since 2015. (and still do)

points: Czech often loves perfect — English does not always.

cards.title: Quick check
points: I ___ (live) here for twelve years. (still here) → **have lived**

cards.title: Remember
cards.body: Finished time or story step → past simple. Link to now → present perfect.
points: Ask: is the time closed, or still connected to now?
